title: Commerce Conversation Reliability Gate — reviewed manifest (C1-PR1)
review_rules: Every allowance below is a recorded, empirically measured failure at base_sha. It is never a permission.
Owners marked UNASSIGNED and expiry null are proposals for owner review; the gate warns on them and never fills them in.

A changed failure signature, an expired allowance, an unexpected pass, or a missing allowed test fails the gate with a RECONCILE marker; the manifest must be re-reviewed by a human, never broadened by the harness.
A baseline-compatible gate result is NOT production acceptance.
Node ids are pytest item node ids exactly as JUnit reports them; parametrized Arabic ids therefore use pytest's escaped \uXXXX form.
Baseline entries are reproduced current implementation defects; replacement_contracts are unapproved future decisions tracked separately and never measured as coverage.
A JUnit expected-failure message must equal the recorded marker exactly (whitespace-normalised); extra cause text fails reconciliation.

baseline_failures.title: Fulfillment lock blocks a new discovery request
baseline_failures.proposed_owner: Order context gate maintainers — proposal only
baseline_failures.evidence: Phase C0 report §11 (RCA defect 6); locked fulfillment session (order_prep with missing fields): for the deterministic ask_product request 'عندكم تنانير؟' the real DefaultDecisionEngine returns llm_reply ('active order — generic alternate-product enquiry') and the catalog interpreter is gated off (returns None); for 'فيه تنانير؟' try_fulfillment_lock_continuation returns propose_draft_order. The same request in an unlocked browsing state reaches search_products (control test). Reproduced at base_sha.
baseline_failures.proposed_expiry: owner decision; an actual date is required for approval
baseline_failures.removal_condition: Verified replacement and path retirement, or a merged change that routes an explicit new-category discovery request during fulfillment to product search without weakening fulfillment answers; unapproved future decision, not authorised by this harness. The test then passes and this entry is deleted in the same PR.
baseline_failures.classification: reproduced current implementation defect (isolated application-boundary characterisation)

baseline_failures.title: Commerce Agent V2 owner path: a rejected send ends with inferred end_ok and no delivery record
baseline_failures.classification: reproduced current implementation defect (isolated application-boundary characterisation); replacement contract tracked separately as RC-01
baseline_failures.proposed_owner: Commerce Agent V2 owners — proposal only
baseline_failures.evidence: Phase C0 report §5/§13; reproduced at base_sha: with outbound_enabled_for_tenant patched True and a scripted 400 on the text send, the lifecycle ends end_ok with no provider message id, no outcome record and no outbound row. Exact recorded observation: provider HTTP 400 on the text send, transport rejected_definitive, no accepted id, lifecycle end_ok, no outbound row, no outcome record. This does not prove the V2 owner is activated in production.
baseline_failures.proposed_expiry: owner decision; an actual date is required for approval
baseline_failures.removal_condition: Verified replacement (RC-01) retires this path, or a merged change closes every V2-owned turn with a provider-accepted id, a human handoff or an explicit failure record; then the test passes and this entry is deleted in the same PR. Not authorised by this harness.

baseline_failures.title: Concurrent brain-state saves lose an independently changed field
baseline_failures.classification: reproduced current implementation defect (isolated application-boundary characterisation); replacement contract tracked separately as RC-02
baseline_failures.proposed_owner: Brain state persistence maintainers — proposal only
baseline_failures.evidence: Phase C0 report §6; reproduced at base_sha with two independent spawned processes calling the real DefaultStateStore.save against a disposable PostgreSQL database. Exact recorded observation: both workers report saved; exactly one of the two independently changed fields survives; the surviving value equals the value that worker wrote.
baseline_failures.proposed_expiry: owner decision; an actual date is required for approval
baseline_failures.removal_condition: Verified replacement (RC-02) retires this path, or a merged change makes concurrent DefaultStateStore.save unable to lose an update; then the test passes and this entry is deleted in the same PR. Not authorised by this harness.

postgres.database_policy: one disposable database per test session, created with ENCODING 'UTF8' TEMPLATE template0, dropped WITH (FORCE) at teardown

debt_policy.acceptance_mode: Every allowance (baseline failure or unimplemented contract) must carry an assigned owner and an explicit, unexpired expiry. UNASSIGNED owners or null expiry are unapproved debt and fail the acceptance gate.
debt_policy.diagnostic_mode: Measures the current baseline with the same reconciliation rules; reports NOT ACCEPTED always and exits non-zero; never a merge/release verdict.
debt_policy.proposals: owner / expiry values below marked UNASSIGNED / null are proposals for owner decision; the harness never assigns them.
